The ambition is a new small, usable prototype roughly each month. The schedule is a creative goal, not a guarantee.

A working approach

Less presentation.
More participation.

I prefer exploring ideas through things you can use. These prototypes are invitations to try a concept, notice what works, and consider what might be better. They aren't endorsements, finished services, or a substitute for the original sources they may reference.
